title: Unsupervised and few-shot segmentation in photovoltaic electroluminescence images for defect detection via a novel enhanced iterative autoencoder
mechanism: Iterative autoencoder trained only on normal EL images reconstructs a defect-free cell; residuals give unsupervised pixel-level defect maps; few masks extend it to few-shot.
evidence: R: better pixel-level metrics than unsupervised and few-shot baselines on PV EL (numbers not in abstract).
adaptation: Bold bet for E1: train on pool half and full cells, where scuffs are common and so learned as normal; feed the residual as an input channel. Opposite failure mode to CrackCue on scuffs. Also a label-free baseline for the benchmark.
min_experiment: Arm: house + EI-AE residual channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: E1 crack precision and relF1@2 in scuff cells, test crack IoU. Kill: E1 relF1@2 < +0.03.
prior_overlap: none. Anomaly-detection priors are listed as never tried.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train on pool cells the house ensemble calls defect-free, including the 1,152 multi half-cut pool cells, and feed the residual map as a 2nd input channel; target E1 where 70% of crack pixels get p(crack) < 0.001. Scuff streaks will also be anomalous, so the supervised head must learn to reject them.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house 2-channel (EL + anomaly residual). Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train on pool cells the house model calls crack-free, including the 1,152 multi half-cells, and feed the anomaly map as an extra input channel so E1 cracks that the model now gives p < 0.001 get a second signal.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF + AE anomaly channel. Baseline: PF, 5 seeds. Metric: E1 crack relR@2 at matched relP@2. Kill if gain < +0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: EL-native AD baseline: train on clean cells per source; few-shot arm with the 42 inactive cells; evaluate with 2 px tolerant crack metrics.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark entry: pixel AUROC / AU-PRO / SegF1 on test and E1; no kill line.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train on clean cells per source; few-shot arm with the 42 inactive cells; EL-native AD baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Benchmark AD track: report pixel metrics per class on CV and E1; few-shot arm vs PF on inactive IoU with kill at < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train on pool cells including the 1,152 multi half-cells so half-cut layout counts as normal; feed the anomaly map as an extra input channel to the house model for E1. Scuffs will also score as anomalies, so the supervised model must still reject them.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm house + anomaly-map channel vs house, 5 seeds; E1 crack recall at matched test precision; kill if E1 recall gain < 0.05.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train on about 6k pool half and full cells (scuffs common there, so learned as normal); use the residual as an extra input channel; contrast with CrackCue which never sees scuffs. Also a label-free benchmark baseline.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + EI-AE residual channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: E1 crack precision and relF1@2 in scuff cells. Kill: < +0.03 E1 relF1@2.

alt_notes.adaptation: Train on defect-free pool cells (house predicts no crack/inactive); residual map as 2nd input channel or crack/inactive proposal for E1-like cells where house gives p<0.001; EL benchmark baseline if code is obtainable.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Residual map as extra channel to house PF on cv5v2; metric out-of-fold crack relF1@2 and F51 crack recall; kill under margin M.
